claims.text: The OSG dataset was developed by crawling and pre-processing an online support group web forum.
The dataset contains 295 thousand conversations and 1.5 million comments after de-duplication.
Each conversation in the OSG dataset is multi-threaded, requiring extraction of conversation threads for analysis.
